ev-primary.quote: The fuel train shall deliver stable pressure to the burner manifold, and low fuel pressure protection shall isolate the train before unsafe combustion develops.

ev-community.quote: A community-level maintenance pattern links high filter differential pressure, low downstream fuel pressure, inspection of the filter element, and verification of trip readiness.

ev-graph.quote: Filter restriction can lower burner-manifold fuel pressure; the resulting lean fuel-air condition can reduce combustion stability and increase flame fluctuation.

ev-local.quote: Particulate accumulation can increase filter differential pressure and reduce downstream pressure during high demand; transmitters provide alarms and inspection triggers.
